title: Thanksgiving meal in Florida leads to mass food poisoning incident
summary_full: Local media reported that 18 people fell ill after attending a Thanksgiving lunch at a medical center headquartersA Thanksgiving meal in Florida triggered a bout of food poisoning so bad that local emergency officials said it was a “mass casualty” event as numerous stricken diners were sent to hospital.Local media reported that 18 people at the Leon medical center headquarters in Doral fell ill due to possible food poisoning after attending the center’s annual Thanksgiving lunch on Wednesday.
